name: video-capcut
title: 编辑和导出视频剪辑
description: Get edited video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something like "trim the clip, add text overlays, and sync cuts to the beat", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for TikTok creators who move fast and want quick automated edits without learning complex software.
title_en: Video CapCut — Edit and Export Video Clips
